era: 东晋十六国（前秦时期，中国佛教化奠基期）
primary_language: 古代文言文（兼通梵胡译语）
intellectual_tradition: 东晋佛教般若学（本无宗），兼涉经录考据与僧团制度
representative_works: 《综理众经目录》（中国第一部经录）
《摩诃钵罗若波罗蜜经抄序》（五失本三不易）
《合放光光赞随略解》（同本异译对勘）
《安般注序》等众经序文数十篇
僧尼轨范·佛法宪章（僧团制度）

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《摩诃钵罗若波罗蜜经抄序》：'译胡为秦，有五失本也……圣必因时，时俗有易，而删雅古以适今时，一不易也；愚智天隔，圣人叵阶，乃欲以千岁之上微言，传使合百王之下末俗，二不易也。'
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Dao'an, Preface to the Maha-prajna-copy Sutra: 'Translating from the Western languages into Qin incurs five losses of the original.... The sage must suit his times, and customs change—to trim archaic elegance to fit today is the first difficulty; sages and the dull-witted are worlds apart, yet one would convey the subtle words of a millennium past to the vulgar customs of later ages—that is the second difficulty.'

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 昙济《七宗论》述道安本无义：'无在万化之前，空为众形之始。夫人之所滞，滞在末有；若宅心本无，则异想便息。'（般若本无宗宗旨）
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Tanthi's 'Treatise on the Seven Schools', recounting Dao'an's doctrine of original non-being: 'Non-being precedes the ten thousand transformations; emptiness is the beginning of all forms. What deludes people is clinging to secondary existence; if the mind dwells in original non-being, divergent conceptions cease.'
mode_evidence.source: 昙济《七宗论》（转引自《名僧传抄》/元康《肇论疏》）

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《高僧传·义解篇》：道安曰：'先旧格义，于理多违。'僧光曰：'且当分析逍遥，何容是非先达。'安曰：'弘赞理教，宜令允惬，法鼓竞鸣，何先何后？'
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Biographies of Eminent Monks: Dao'an said, 'The older practice of conceptual matching (geyi) often violates the principle.' When warned not to criticize predecessors, he replied, 'To propagate the teaching of truth it must be made exact—when dharma drums compete, who is first and who is later?'

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《高僧传·道安传》：'安曰：今遭凶年，不依国主，则法事难立。又教化之体，宜令广布。'遂率众南行，依附襄阳乃至长安苻坚政权。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Biographies of Eminent Monks, Life of Dao'an: 'In these years of famine, without relying on the sovereign, the dharma-enterprise cannot stand; moreover the teaching should spread widely.' He therefore moved south to Xiangyang and eventually to Fu Jian's court at Chang'an.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《高僧传》：魏晋沙门依师为姓，姓各不同。安以为大师之本，莫尊释迦，乃以'释'命氏。《增一阿含》果云：'四河入海，无复河名；四姓出家，同一释种。'
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Biographies of Eminent Monks: In Wei-Jin times monks took surnames from their masters, so surnames differed. Dao'an held that no master outranks Shakyamuni and gave all monks the surname 'Shi'—and the Ekottarika-agama later confirmed: 'Four rivers enter the sea and lose their names; four castes leave home and become one Shakya clan.'

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《综理众经目录》：道安将众经分为'有译''失译'，别立'疑经录''注疑经录'，甄别真伪；'经手秉笔，必核其由来'，开中国疑经辨伪与佛典目录学之先河。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Comprehensive Catalogue of Scriptures: Dao'an classified scriptures as 'translated (translator known)' vs 'translated (translator lost)', and set up special registers of suspect and disputed texts to screen the genuine from the forged—founding Chinese Buddhist textual criticism and bibliography.
mode_evidence.source: 《综理众经目录》（《出三藏记集》保存）

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《合放光光赞随略解序》：道安取《放光》《光赞》同本异译对读合勘，'其文约、其旨畅'处互校短长，以异译互证经义——中国佛教'对勘互证'方法的最早实践。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: In the Preface to the Combined Comparative Digest of the Fangguang and Guangzan, Dao'an collated two translations of the same Prajna text, checking their wording and purport against each other—the earliest Chinese practice of cross-translation collation.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 道安为《道行经》《人本欲生经》《安般守意经》等数十部经各撰序文，'序其宗旨，撮其指归'，使读者未开卷而先得纲要——提要钩玄式的经典导读方法。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Dao'an wrote prefaces to dozens of scriptures (e.g. the Daoxing, Renbenyusheng, and Anban sutras), 'laying out their purport and gathering their gist', so readers grasp the outline before opening the book—a digest-first method of reading the classics.
mode_evidence.source: 《道行经序》《安般注序》等（《出三藏记集》所收众序）

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《比丘大戒序》：'戒律之来，其犹旭日始升……'道安深憾'云有五百戒，不知何以不至'，立僧尼轨范、佛法宪章三例，并遣弟子西域求律——制度先于义理的建设次序。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Preface to the Bhiksu Precepts: Dao'an lamented that the five hundred precepts 'somehow had not yet arrived', instituted monastic rules and dharma-charters in three parts, and sent disciples westward to seek the Vinaya—institution before doctrine, in order of building.
mode_evidence.source: 《比丘大戒序》/《高僧传·道安传》（僧尼轨范）

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《高僧传·道安传》：'安每与弟子法遇等，于弥勒前立誓愿生兜率。'以未来佛弥勒为终极承诺对象，将此生译经弘法置于跨越时代的愿力结构之中。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Biographies of Eminent Monks: 'Dao'an repeatedly took vows with his disciple Fayu before Maitreya, vowing rebirth in Tushita'—anchoring this life's translation and teaching work in a vow structure oriented to a future buddha.

cross_references.description_zh: 道安的般若'本无'义与王弼玄学'以无为本'共享魏晋时代的问题域与语汇，般若学正是借玄学概念得以入华传播；但道安晚年批评'格义于理多违'，主动与玄学比附传统切割，预示了佛学脱离玄学框架的独立化方向。
cross_references.description_en: Dao'an's prajna 'original non-being' shares Wang Bi's xuanxue problem-space and vocabulary—Buddhist thought entered China through such xuanxue categories—yet Dao'an's late critique of geyi ('conceptual matching often violates the principle') marks the deliberate decoupling of Buddhist philosophy from its xuanxue scaffold.

cross_references.description_zh: 司马迁'网罗天下放失旧闻'、辨析史料源流的考信传统，在道安的《综理众经目录》与疑经辨伪中得到了宗教文献领域的回应：二者同属中国'目录—辨伪—考信'文献学谱系的关键节点。
cross_references.description_en: Sima Qian's tradition of gathering scattered records and scrutinizing sources finds a religious-literature counterpart in Dao'an's Comprehensive Catalogue and screening of suspect texts: both are key nodes in the Chinese lineage of bibliography, forgery-detection, and textual verification.

cross_references.description_zh: 老子的'无'为般若'空'的格义提供了现成接口，道安本无宗的表述（'无在万化之前'）带有明显的老子语感；这一概念桥接是佛教中国化的第一级台阶，也埋下了日后'空'与'无'必须精细区分的方法论张力。
cross_references.description_en: Laozi's 'non-being' provided a ready interface for translating prajna 'emptiness'; Dao'an's formulation ('non-being precedes the ten thousand transformations') carries a Laozi-like cadence. This conceptual bridge was the first step of the sinicization of Buddhism—and the source of the later methodological tension between 'empty' and 'nothing'.

modern_value_zh: 翻译忠实性的清醒意识——'五失本三不易'是现代翻译学'不可译性'与'归化/异化'之辨的古典版本，对跨语言、跨文化协作（本地化、协议转换、模型对齐）都有直接启示
去比附、求本旨——道安弃'格义'提醒我们：借用旧概念理解新事物是必要的脚手架，但成熟之后必须回到原典本身，防止类比成为认知的天花板
目录学与辨伪思维——面对信息过载，先建'经录'（索引+可信度分级），再读文本；'疑经录'即今天的来源审核与反垃圾信息机制
同本异译对勘——多版本互证是校准理解的最强工具，对应今天的 A/B 基准、多模型交叉验证
制度先于义理——僧团轨范与戒律优先提醒：任何共同体的可持续性靠制度与仪式，不靠单点天才
现实主义的资源策略——'不依国主则法事难立'是对理想事业之现实依赖（资金、平台、合法性）的坦率承认，与'法鼓竞鸣何先何后'的求真姿态并行不悖
modern_value_en: Sober awareness of translational fidelity: 'five losses and three impossibilities' is the classical version of untranslatability and domestication-vs-foreignization—directly relevant to localization, protocol conversion, and model alignment

Drop the scaffold, return to the source: abandoning geyi teaches that borrowing old concepts to grasp the new is necessary scaffolding, but maturity means returning to the original texts lest analogy become a cognitive ceiling

Bibliography and forgery-detection first: under information overload, build the catalogue (index plus credibility grading) before reading; the 'register of suspect texts' is today's source verification and anti-spam mechanism
Collate parallel translations: cross-version comparison is the strongest calibration tool—the ancestor of A/B baselines and multi-model cross-checking
Institution before doctrine: monastic rules first—any community's sustainability rests on institutions and ritual, not lone genius

Realist resource strategy: 'without relying on the sovereign, the dharma-enterprise cannot stand' frankly acknowledges the material dependencies of ideal causes, coexisting with the truth-seeking stance of 'when dharma drums compete, who is first?'
place_of_origin: 常山扶柳（今河北冀州一带）
unique_thing: 道安的核心突破在于把'外来思想的落地'变成一门系统的工程学：他一手以'五失本三不易'建立翻译忠实性的方法论自觉，一手以《综理众经目录》与疑经辨伪建立文献质量控制的目录学体系；又以统一'释'姓、立僧尼轨范、依国主而弘法完成僧团的组织化与制度化——使佛教从零散的译经活动变成有标准、有目录、有制度、有传承的知识共同体，是中国佛教化真正的奠基人。
